plan.goal: Create 600-foot buffers around each coffee shop point to define the proximity search area.
plan.notes: Input CRS is EPSG:6535 (NAD83 / New York Long Island ftUS), so the buffer distance is exactly 600 units (feet). Output preserves original coffee shop attributes.

plan.goal: Count the number of bus and metro stops located within each coffee shop buffer using a spatial join.
plan.notes: Perform a spatial intersection or 'within' join between the stop points and the coffee shop buffers. Aggregate the count of stops per buffer and attach it as a new field named 'stop_count' to the original coffee shop attributes.

plan.goal: Sort the coffee shops by the stop_count field in descending order and retain only the top 20 features.
plan.notes: Filter the dataset to keep the 20 rows with the highest stop_count values. Maintain the original point geometry and all associated attributes. Output as a Shapefile.
